label: Mineral and clay surfaces
description: Records the identity, form, amount and preparation of mineral or clay solids used as catalysts or adsorbents. Applies to mineral-catalysed oligomerisation, clay-catalysed condensation and mineral adsorption experiments.
covers: Mineral or clay identity and class, formula, exchangeable cation, mass, particle size, pretreatment and structural Fe3+ content.

variable_categories.label: Mineral surfaces
variable_categories.description: Mineral or clay identity, form, amount and preparation.

pack_parameters.description: Mineral or clay sample tested, as named in the paper (e.g. galena, Na-montmorillonite).
Mass of mineral or clay solid added to each reaction.

row_rules: When a paper compares several minerals or clay cation forms, give each its own row.
